title: Silgan联手美资伙伴收购Trivium 金属包装整合提速
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: a major consolidation in the packaging industry this morning.
segments.zh: 今早包装行业出现重大整合。

segments.en: Silgan is teaming up with American industrial partners to acquire trivia and packaging in a transaction valued at about $3.4 billion. The transaction will create
segments.zh: Silgan与美国工业合作伙伴联手收购Trivia and Packaging，交易价值约34亿美元。该交易将打造

segments.en: Silgan metal containers and closures with Silgan retaining a controlling stake in the business.
segments.zh: Silgan金属容器与封盖业务，Silgan保留该业务的控股权。

segments.en: Please to say joining us to discuss is Silgan present and CEO, Adam Greenley. Adam, congratulations on the deal. Thanks for joining us. And look, you've been on quite the
segments.zh: 很高兴邀请到Silgan总裁兼CEO Adam Greenley参与讨论。Adam，恭喜达成交易，感谢加入。你看，你们一直走在

segments.en: acquisitive path. You've bought a packaging company in 2024. You tried earlier this year to buy a German medical packageer that ended up falling through and now this deal.
segments.zh: 收购道路上。2024年收购了一家包装公司，今年早些时候尝试收购一家德国医疗包装企业但未成功，现在又有了这笔交易。

segments.en: Why is now the right time to be aggressive and to be growing the company via acquisitions?
segments.zh: 为什么现在是积极通过收购扩张公司的合适时机？

segments.en: Well, good morning and thanks for having us. We're excited to talk about today's transaction and the great thing about today's transaction is it also fits right in line with our core strategy
segments.zh: 早上好，感谢邀请。我们很高兴谈论今天的交易，这笔交易与我们核心战略高度契合

segments.en: since our company was founded 39 years ago. We believe we have a core competency in M&A and we've acquired 41 companies in our 39 years, excuse me. And so this fits right in line
segments.zh: 自公司39年前成立以来。我们相信我们在并购方面拥有核心能力，39年间已收购41家公司。所以这完全符合

segments.en: with what we've always done. So it's right at the core of what Silgan is about and we're really excited about creating the premier global metal packaging platform by the acquisition of trivia
segments.zh: 我们一贯的做法。这是Silgan的核心所在，我们非常兴奋通过收购Trivia Packaging打造全球领先的金属包装平台

segments.en: packaging and combining it with Silgan's metal packaging business as well as our closures business as well. Yeah, let's go into a little bit more of the details about what exactly Silgan is able to
segments.zh: 并将其与Silgan的金属包装业务以及封盖业务相结合。是的，让我们更详细地了解Silgan究竟能够

segments.en: do now that maybe you weren't able to do before this acquisition. Sure, I think that the businesses are highly complimentary and that's a key component here of the strategic rationale behind the
segments.zh: 现在做那些在收购前可能无法做的事情。当然，我认为这些业务高度互补，这是战略理由的关键组成部分。
